description: 再生能源發電量月資料 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部能源署. 1. 資料內涵：我國當月呈現慣常水力、地熱、太陽光電、風力（陸域、離岸）、生質能（固態、氣態）及廢棄物發電技術產生之再生能源毛發電量統計資料。 2. 收集目的：做為我國能源相關政策規劃與管理之依據。 3. 收集方式： (1)慣常水力、地熱、太陽光電、風力：記錄各類發電技術毛發電量，來自發電業、自用發電設備、售電業（躉購第三型再生能源發電設... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部能源署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-03 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
